resources.string: A keyboard that learns how you type, not how everyone types.
Turn on Kboard in your phone keyboard settings.
Choose Kboard as the keyboard you type with.
Kboard is your active keyboard. Try it below.
Each kind of key has its own vibration.
Kboard stops learning from what you type while this is on.
Deletes every word Kboard has learned. This cannot be undone.

Kboard has no internet permission, so nothing you type can leave your phone. It remembers the words you use to suggest them again, and keeps them only on this phone. It never learns in password, email or web address fields, or in incognito mode. You can delete everything it learned at any time.
